settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure common system settings and review security notes

general.logLevelReadonly: Log level is managed via the server config file or environment variables.
general.apiTlsEnableDesc: Serve the API over HTTPS using ACME certificates
general.apiDomainDesc: Domain name for the API server TLS certificate. Requires ACME to be enabled.
general.configViaFileDesc: API TLS settings (<0>api_tls</0>, <1>api_domain</1>) require a server restart to take effect. Configure them in the TOML config file or via environment variables.
general.acmeWarning: ACME is not enabled. Enable ACME first to use API TLS.
general.reverseProxyDesc: Reverse proxy rules are managed on the <0>Reverse Proxy</0> page. Create and configure HTTP, TCP, and UDP proxy rules there.

security.title: Security Configuration
security.note: Security-sensitive configuration (admin password, JWT secret, client auth token) is managed via the server configuration file and cannot be changed at runtime.
security.changeNote: To change these values, edit the TOML config file or set environment variables, then restart the server.
